blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Mayor Nestor Archival has been ordered to formally respond to allegations that his property interest in Monterrazas de Cebu may have influenced his handling of the controversial development. The Office of the Ombudsman directed him to submit a counter-affidavit as it proceeds with its criminal and administrative investigation into the matter. […]...
